record.paper_title: Open Problems in Quantum Information Theory
record.context_brief: First tensor-power failure of Rényi additivity
record.original_question: Find a quantum channel Φ, an integer m, and a real p > 0 such that minimal output Rényi entropy is additive for fewer than m tensor powers, S^p_min(Φ^{⊗n}) = n S^p_min(Φ) for n < m, but fails exactly at m copies in the sense S^p_min(Φ^{⊗m}) < m S^p_min(Φ).

evidence.quote: The need for large dimensions to find counter-examples raises the question of whether channels for smaller dimensions might satisfy (26) for two copies, but not for a large number.
Problem 19. Find an example of a channel Φ, an integer m and a p > 0 such that Spmin(Φ⊗n) = nSpmin(Φ) for n < m but Spmin(Φ⊗m) < mSpmin(Φ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a quantum channel $\Phi:\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_A)\to\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_B)$ (a completely positive trace-preserving linear map between matrix algebras) and a real number $p>0$, define the minimal output Rényi $p$-entropy by
$$S^{p}_{\min}(\Phi)\;=\;\inf_{\rho}\;\frac{1}{1-p}\,\log\,\mathrm{Tr}\!\left[\Phi(\rho)^{p}\right],$$
where the infimum is over all density matrices $\rho$ on $\mathcal{H}_A$ (and the limit $p\to 1$ recovers the von Neumann entropy). For an integer $n\ge 1$, let $\Phi^{\otimes n}$ denote the $n$-fold tensor product channel acting on $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}_A^{\otimes n})$.

Exhibit a quantum channel $\Phi$, an integer $m\ge 2$, and a real number $p>0$ such that the minimal output Rényi $p$-entropy is exactly additive for fewer than $m$ tensor copies but fails to be additive at $m$ copies, namely
$$S^{p}_{\min}(\Phi^{\otimes n})\;=\;n\,S^{p}_{\min}(\Phi)\quad\text{for all }1\le n<m,$$
while
$$S^{p}_{\min}(\Phi^{\otimes m})\;<\;m\,S^{p}_{\min}(\Phi).$$
Equivalently, find a quantum channel for which the first failure of Rényi additivity occurs at exactly $m$ copies, with $m\ge 2$.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has produced many counterexamples to additivity of minimum output Rényi $p$-entropy (random Stinespring constructions for $p>1$, antisymmetric-subspace channels for all $p>2$, and small-dimensional examples for $p$ near $0$), and Hayden–Winter showed non-additivity for all $p>1$. However, no source located addresses the specific structural question of producing a channel whose Rényi additivity holds for all $n<m$ tensor copies and first fails at exactly $n=m$ for some prescribed $m\ge 2$. The problem appears not to have been explicitly resolved.

status_evidence.title: Counterexamples to additivity of minimum output p-Rényi entropy for p close to 0
status_evidence.snippet: Explicit channels from 4 to 3 dimensions with non-multiplicative minimum output rank; numerics suggest p-Rényi entropy non-additive for p ≲ 0.11.
status_evidence.claim: Non-additivity counterexamples exist but the 'first failure at m copies' question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Constructive counterexamples to additivity of minimum output Rényi entropy of quantum channels for all p>2
status_evidence.snippet: Antisymmetric-subspace channels yield non-additivity for all p>2.
status_evidence.claim: General non-additivity is established for p>2, without addressing the prescribed first-failure index m.

status_evidence.title: Note on Multiple Additivity of Minimal Renyi Entropy Output of the Werner-Holevo Channels
status_evidence.snippet: Arbitrary tensor products of Werner-Holevo channels obey Rényi additivity for p≤1.
status_evidence.claim: Some channels are fully additive, not exhibiting the staged failure sought.
